kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتفاضل (form VI)
# نَتَفَاضَلُ (natafāḍalu) /na.ta.faː.dˤa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
# نَتَفَاضَلَ (natafāḍala) /na.ta.faː.dˤa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
# نَتَفَاضَلْ (natafāḍal) /na.ta.faː.dˤal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
